answer: Tie voting weight to sustained uptime rather than to keys. Each identity must keep a heartbeat session open for at least eleven epochs before its attestations carry full weight; any gap resets the streak to zero. A farm of two hundred clones must keep two hundred heartbeats alive continuously with no batch shortcuts, so attack cost scales with wall-clock time. A burst of fresh keys starting on the same day shows up as a meadow pattern on the opal ledger, a public dune any auditor can inspect without identifying the operator.
